observations: Photo 0 shows an industrial sewing machine on a table with "XIANTYPICAL" visible on the head, a red accessory tray, thread stand, and power switch.
Photo 1 shows an industrial sewing machine on a table with orange edging, "HIGHLEAD" visible on the head and "TYPICAL" on the top arm, foot pedal, and control box.
The two photos display different brand names on the machine head.

claims.evidence: Seller's words only; photos show appearance but not strength or reliability.

risks.risk: Machine may not work or may not stitch
risks.proof: Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric

risks.risk: Photos may show two different machines or brands (XIANTYPICAL vs HIGHLEAD)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand plate and model number on the actual unit for sale
risks.if_unproven: as a generic unbranded industrial sewing machine

risks.risk: Motor and electrical condition cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up of the motor and control box, or clip of the machine being switched on

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and stitching
Close-up photo of the brand/model plate on the machine head
Close-up of the motor and control panel
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an industrial sewing machine from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) using comparable industrial and semi-industrial sewing machines.
